short_description: Semantic Field Fabric and its derived visual lab on top of accepted G3/G5/G6 world-generation truth.
purpose: Build stable semantic world fields independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation, then expose them for debug/visual inspection before G8 geomorphology.
expected_outcome: Accepted G7 semantic-field foundation plus a graphical proof that real adapter-backed fields remain stable while derived presentation LOD visibly changes mesh density without debug-shell occlusion artifacts.
progress_note: Manual screenshot review after Fix3 automated acceptance confirmed LOD0..LOD3, 33x17->5x3 presentation grids and the invariant 561 semantic samples, but exposed two derived-presentation defects: negative-height/coarse mesh portions could be occluded by the radius-8 debug sphere, producing false dark holes, and the canonical river overlay was only a one-pixel line. Fix4 is now implemented as a presentation-only wrapper: a height-range-derived uniform radial shell lift reserves 0.075 display-unit minimum vertex clearance including coarse-LOD chord guard, and the accepted canonical river centerline is rendered as a narrow diagnostic triangle-strip ribbon above the patch. Semantic queries/values/IDs/checksums and the LOD contract are unchanged. Fresh Windows focused revalidation is now required; the previous automated PASS at 661b0eec is historical only.
next_stage: Run fresh G7.4 focused Windows validation for Fix4. If green, refresh PC0 evidence, rerun G7.4 full automated acceptance, then repeat the shortened graphical check and accept G7.4 before G7 full acceptance and G8 geomorphology.

ownership_claims.scope: semantic fields and derived G7 presentation
